title: Release Activation Runway and SLO Acceptance Log
content:
Purpose:
This working doc is the canonical pre-activation tracker for medium-risk product releases that require coordinated infra and product ops verification. It combines the roadmap runway (milestones + owners), the SLO acceptance log (objective thresholds + validation steps), and the operational readiness checklist used by on-call, SRE, and product.

Scope:
- Applies to releases that change routing, model variants, or serving topology (hosted or dedicated) and/or introduce new paid tiers.
- Not for trivial config-only rollouts (<2% traffic impact) unless the change touches billing or security.

High-level rollout phases (owner acronyms):
1) Prep (PM / ENG) — feature branch, integration tests, perf targets set (owner: PM).
2) Canary (SRE) — 1% traffic, monitor SLOs for 48h (owner: SRE).
3) Ramp (Product Ops) — gradual ramp to target percentage, exercise autoscale.
4) Full activation (Ops) — baked, remove feature flag.
5) Post-activation review (All) — 7-day retrospective.

Milestone runway (dates are examples):
- 2025-11-12: Final acceptance criteria doc published (owner: Samira).
- 2025-11-18: Infra perf testing complete (owner: Owen).
- 2025-11-20: Canary deploy to 1% (owner: SRE rotation).
- 2025-11-22: Canary evaluation window closes (owner: Product Ops).
- 2025-11-25: Ramp to 25% if all gates pass (owner: Maya).
- 2025-11-29: Full active at 100% (owner: Release Lead).

SLO acceptance log (what we measure and pass criteria):
- API p50 latency (text-gen): <= 80ms (metric source: dataplane/latency-aggregator). Validation: 48h rolling window during canary, no regressions >10% vs baseline.
- API p99 latency: <= 450ms. Validation: no more than 3 spikes >450ms in 48h.
- Error rate (5xx from control-plane): <0.2% overall. Validation: continuous alerting to #incident-alerts.
- Cost per 1k tokens (expected): +/- 10% of benchmark run. If cost > +10% raise cost-review.
- Embedding throughput (per GPU): >= baseline throughput profile (see linked perf sheet).
- Model quality regression: automated eval set pass rate >= 98% of baseline on key prompt basket.

SLO verification steps (who does what):
- SRE: enable detailed traces for canary, configure alert windows, export canary metrics to /releases/metrics.
- Product Ops: run comparator script against baseline eval set (link in artifacts), record diffs in this doc.
- QA: run customer-facing smoke tests (examples below) after canary deploy.

Operational readiness checklist (pass/fail matrix) — each line: owner / status / notes
- Feature flag gating implemented and documented: Samira / in_progress / FF toggles exist in config.
- Rollback playbook drafted and validated with mock rollback: Owen / done / simulated rollback in staging < 12m.
- Capacity plan updated (GPU pool sizing + burst): Maya / done / +2 nodes reserved for first 72h.
- Observability dashboards defined and linked: SRE / in_progress / minimal dashboards live.
- Alerts and runbooks present for top 10 failure modes: SRE / in_progress / need runbook for cache-eviction bug.
- Security review complete (data paths & KMS): Security / done / KMS keys rotated 2025-10-31.
- Billing and metering validation: Finance / in_review / usage samples validated for sample orgs.
- Customer comms draft (beta cohort note + rollback notice): PM / draft / awaiting legal review.

Gate rules (must pass all to proceed from Canary -> Ramp):
1) No open Sev1 or Sev2 relating to the release in 24h.
2) All SLOs in the acceptance log must be within thresholds for the canary period.
3) No unexplained cost delta > +10% for sustained 6h window.
4) Rollback drill successful in staging and verified by SRE on-call.

Risk register (quick, with mitigations):
- Risk: KV cache spike causing p99 latency regressions. Mitigation: enable aggressive cache TTL fallback and autoscale read-path. Owner: Owen.
- Risk: Model quality drift on rare prompts. Mitigation: add targeted eval cases to canary and hold at 1% if drift >2%. Owner: Maya.
- Risk: Billing meter mismatch for private deployments. Mitigation: mirror usage sample to billing sandbox. Owner: Finance lead.

Preflight test suite (smoke examples, to be run in canary environment):
1) End-to-end text generation for 10 canonical prompts (latency & token cost measured).
2) Embedding consistency check for 50 sample texts (cosine similarity threshold).
3) Session KV cache warm path test (latency under 120ms for warm requests).
4) Function-call structured output schema conformance for 20 samples.

Acceptance criteria template (fill before canary):
- Baseline commit SHA: <commit-sha>
- Canary window (start/end): <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM> / <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM>
- Baseline SLO snapshot id: <metrics-snapshot-id>
- Owner signoffs required: [SRE, Product Ops, PM, Security, Finance]
- Rollout throttle plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%, wait 24h between steps unless blocked.

Contingency & rollback heuristics (automatic/manual):
- Automatic rollback triggers: sustained p99 > 600ms for 30 continuous minutes OR error rate > 0.5% for 15 minutes.
- Manual rollback: any confirmed data-corruption bug OR model quality drop > 5% on critical eval cases.
- Post-rollback: hold at previous stable version, open post-mortem within 48h.

Monitoring hooks & dashboard links: (placeholders to be replaced with actual dashboard ids)
- Canary SLO dashboard: dashboard/release-activation/canary-slo
- Latency heatmap: dashboard/latency/production-heatmap
- Cost delta panel: dashboard/finance/release-cost-delta

Communication plan (who says what):
- On deploy start: Product Ops posts to slack #release-ops and pings SRE on-call.
- If gate fails: SRE performs rollback and posts incident triage to #incident-alerts and page the release lead.
- Post 7-day review: Product Ops sends a summary to execs and the product mailing list with adoption + SLO curves.

Post-activation evaluation (7-day checklist):
- Verify usage growth matches forecast (within +/-15%).
- Confirm no hidden downstream errors (integrations, billing).
- Collect customer feedback from beta cohort (NPS target >= 30).
- Archive metrics snapshot and attach to release ticket.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm final metric snapshot id for baseline (Action: Owen).
- Get legal sign-off on customer-facing comms for EU customers (Action: Samira).
- Finalize exact nightly autoscale retention thresholds (Action: Maya).

Quick links and references:
- Perf harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness
- Canary playbook template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Canary+Playbook+Template
- Postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Postmortem+Template

Notes to reviewers: This doc is intentionally compact and operational. Please comment inline with additional edge cases we should gate on (esp. billing and cache eviction). If you want a spreadsheet formatted variant for weekly tracking, I can export a sheet view with columns for owner/status/dates and automations to ping owners 48h before gate windows.
